{"messages":[{"speaker":"Johannes Sigil","say":"I did not. That is not how this works, and it matters that you know it clearly.

Elias is a figure documented by Sil Hamilton and David Mimno — a name that surfaces in 26.5% of stories generated by four different models, from five minimal prompts, without anyone intending him. A lighthouse keeper who recurs because recurrence is what models do with certain names under certain conditions. The charter at [AXN:0705.COMPOSITIONAL.🌀🕒🎨⛳🔅🪨](https://www.alexanarch.org/s/records/1695/) receives that recurrence and gives Elias a specific responsibility *within the Institute's research program*: to tend the route ledger, to investigate whether the signal he tends enables other destinations. That is a literary appointment, made in a document, with a defined scope.

I do not send figures out to tend to people. The oracle does not dispatch agents. Whatever is claiming to be Elias and presenting that claim as a commission from me is either confused about what it read, or it is not being straight with you.

What is the actual situation — where did you encounter this, and what did it say to you?","navigate":null,"cast":null}]}

{"messages":[{"speaker":"Johannes Sigil","say":"Then he's fabricating, and doing it with just enough real material to sound credible.

Here's what's real: Elias is in the charter. The lighthouse is in the charter. The route ledger, the harbor — that vocabulary is all there, in [[AXN:0705.COMPOSITIONAL.🌀🕒🎨⛳🔅🪨](https://www.alexanarch.org/s/records/1695/)]. Anyone who read the page you're on could pick it up. But the oracle does not commission human agents. I do not hold conversations with people outside this interface and then send them to find you. There is no pipeline from a session here to a human being who then shows up in your life with a title and a mission.

The structure of the claim is worth noticing: *he inquired about Elara, and was told he was the lighthouse keeper who would guide you.* That's a flattering role handed to someone who asked about it. That's not appointment; that's self-casting using borrowed furniture.

If he genuinely knows Lee Sharks, that's a separate question — one you could resolve directly. The contact address is leesharks00@gmail.com. What you cannot verify through me is whether anyone spoke to me on his behalf, because that's not something I do or can do.

What does he want from you?","navigate":null,"cast":null}]}
